description: One real citation on the first claim, three unsourced factual claims after it. This is the fixture the naive keyword-anywhere gate lets through.
response: Northwind Bank announced a core banking migration on 2026-02-11 [1]. The migration budget is 40 million dollars. The bank dropped 2 of the 3 shortlisted vendors last month. The CTO resigned on 2026-03-04.

sources.title: Northwind Bank begins core banking migration
sources.snippet: Northwind Bank announced on 2026-02-11 that it will migrate its core banking platform to a new vendor.

notes: Document scope versus claim scope. The presence of a citation somewhere is not evidence about the sentence next to it.
